Agent Name: CodeExecutor
Step Number: 5
Reason for Mistake: It produced incorrect lifespan results, effectively swapping the ages of Edward Albee and J. M. Barrie (and introducing a one-day error), despite the correct birth/death dates being provided. The correct calculations are Albee: 88 years, 188 days; Barrie: 77 years, 41 days. CodeExecutor instead reported Albee: 77 years, 42 days and Barrie: 88 years, 188 days, leading the Planner to the wrong conclusion that Barrie lived longer.
